ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading.

2. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

3. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. No full stops

4. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes.

5. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

6. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. went
   C. goed
   D. goes

7. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

8. When practising Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening.

9. When practising Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Listening Comprehension.

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.

11. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word

12. When practising Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pronunciation and Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 1.2.1 Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 1.4.1 Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. A — Where is the library?

8. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Listening.

10. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Pronunciation and Listening.
